source_id: BR-MMS-001 Determine whether MMS remains within every function and integration in its stated scope without asserting unlisted behavior.
purpose: Determine whether MMS remains within every function and integration in its stated scope without asserting unlisted behavior.
preconditions: Problem Statement scope is authoritative.

test_data.scope: All MMS artifacts, screens, integrations, and excluded functions

steps: Compare the complete MMS surface against the bounded list of functions and explicit integrations in the Problem Statement.
action_or_input.blocked_reason: The rule is a system-wide scope boundary but does not define a finite acceptance oracle for absence of every out-of-scope function. No unlisted feature or endpoint may be invented for a negative test.

source_id: BR-MMS-002 Verify role assignment can use an available institutional employee identity without changing that identity data.
purpose: Verify role assignment can use an available institutional employee identity without changing that identity data.
preconditions: A current institute employee identity is supplied by the institutional source.
Mess Admin is authorized to assign roles.

steps: Assign the employee to a mess role using the supplied identity.
Compare the source employee identity before and after the assignment.

expected_result: The role assignment is recorded using the supplied employee identity; employee master data is not changed by the role assignment.

source_id: BR-MMS-002 Verify a role assignment is not recorded when the required employee identity is unavailable.
purpose: Verify a role assignment is not recorded when the required employee identity is unavailable.
preconditions: The selected employee identity is unavailable from institutional master data.
Mess Admin attempts an assignment.

steps: Attempt to assign an operational role to the employee whose identity is unavailable.
Inspect role-assignment records.

expected_result: No role assignment is recorded for the unavailable employee.

source_id: BR-MMS-002 Verify the complete employee master-data ownership boundary.
purpose: Verify the complete employee master-data ownership boundary.
preconditions: Employee identity is owned by the institutional source.

test_data.action: Attempt to create, edit, or delete employee master data through MMS

steps: Determine the precise MMS behavior for employee master-data management.
action_or_input.blocked_reason: The specifications state MMS does not own employee master data but do not define a specific employee-management operation or rejection response to exercise. No API/action is inferred.

source_id: BR-MMS-003 Verify exactly one active Caretaker remains after a mid-cycle reassignment.
purpose: Verify exactly one active Caretaker remains after a mid-cycle reassignment.
preconditions: A Caretaker assignment is active.
Mess Admin can reassign the role to an eligible employee.

steps: Reassign the active Caretaker to another eligible employee.
Inspect active Caretaker assignments at the recorded reassignment time.

expected_result: Exactly one Caretaker is active: the replacement; the prior assignment is no longer active.

source_id: BR-MMS-004 Verify exactly one active Warden remains after a mid-cycle reassignment.
purpose: Verify exactly one active Warden remains after a mid-cycle reassignment.
preconditions: A Warden assignment is active.
Mess Admin can reassign the role to an eligible employee.

steps: Reassign the active Warden to another eligible employee.
Inspect active Warden assignments at the recorded reassignment time.

expected_result: Exactly one Warden is active: the replacement; the prior assignment is no longer active.

source_id: BR-MMS-005 Verify Mess Admin cannot access student requests.
purpose: Verify Mess Admin cannot access student requests.
preconditions: At least one student request exists.
Actor is Mess Admin.

steps: Attempt to view operational student request data as Mess Admin.

expected_result: Access is prevented and request data is not disclosed or changed.

source_id: BR-MMS-005 Verify Mess Admin cannot access billing or feedback data.
purpose: Verify Mess Admin cannot access billing or feedback data.
preconditions: A bill and a feedback entry exist.
Actor is Mess Admin.

steps: Attempt to view billing details as Mess Admin.
Attempt to view feedback entries as Mess Admin.

expected_result: Both requests are prevented; neither resource is disclosed or changed.

source_id: BR-MMS-006 Verify a mid-cycle Caretaker reassignment is effective immediately from its recorded time.
purpose: Verify a mid-cycle Caretaker reassignment is effective immediately from its recorded time.
preconditions: A Caretaker is active during a mess cycle.
A replacement employee is eligible.

test_data.effective_time: Recorded reassignment time within the cycle

steps: Reassign the Caretaker mid-cycle.
Check authorization using the previous and replacement assignments immediately before and at/after the recorded reassignment time.

expected_result: The replacement assignment is effective in MMS from its recorded reassignment time, with no deferred cycle-end activation.

source_id: BR-MMS-006 Verify a mid-cycle Warden reassignment is effective immediately from its recorded time.
purpose: Verify a mid-cycle Warden reassignment is effective immediately from its recorded time.
preconditions: A Warden is active during a mess cycle.
A replacement employee is eligible.

test_data.effective_time: Recorded reassignment time within the cycle

steps: Reassign the Warden mid-cycle.
Check the active Warden assignment immediately around the recorded reassignment time.

expected_result: The new Warden assignment takes effect immediately in MMS from the recorded time.

source_id: BR-MMS-007 Verify pending Caretaker-owned operational requests transfer in visibility and actionability to the newly assigned Caretaker.
purpose: Verify pending Caretaker-owned operational requests transfer in visibility and actionability to the newly assigned Caretaker.
preconditions: A pending operational request is owned by the Caretaker role.
A Caretaker reassignment has been recorded.

steps: Reassign the Caretaker.
As the newly assigned Caretaker, view and perform an allowed decision on the pending request.

expected_result: The new active Caretaker can see and act on the pending role-owned request.

source_id: BR-MMS-008 Verify the active Caretaker can open a registration window for a designated cycle or period.
purpose: Verify the active Caretaker can open a registration window for a designated cycle or period.
preconditions: The actor holds the active Caretaker assignment.
A mess cycle/designated period is identified.

test_data.cycle_or_period: A designated mess cycle or period

steps: Submit a registration-window opening action as the active Caretaker.
Inspect the resulting window.

expected_result: The registration window is recorded as opened for the designated cycle or period.

source_id: BR-MMS-008 Verify a non-active Caretaker cannot open a registration window.
purpose: Verify a non-active Caretaker cannot open a registration window.
preconditions: The actor is not the active Caretaker.
No target window has already been opened.

steps: Attempt to open the designated registration window.

expected_result: The action is rejected and no window is opened.

source_id: BR-MMS-009 Verify Student registration is accepted while the registration window is open.
purpose: Verify Student registration is accepted while the registration window is open.
preconditions: A registration window is open.
The actor is a Student.

steps: Submit a registration request during the open interval.
Inspect the created request.

expected_result: MMS allows the Student registration request during the open window.

source_id: BR-MMS-009 Verify Student registration is rejected when no registration window is open.
purpose: Verify Student registration is rejected when no registration window is open.
preconditions: The actor is a Student.
No registration window is open.

steps: Submit a registration request.
Inspect request records.

expected_result: MMS prevents submission and creates no registration request.

source_id: BR-MMS-010 Verify the active Caretaker can approve a registration request and the decision is recorded.
purpose: Verify the active Caretaker can approve a registration request and the decision is recorded.
preconditions: A registration request is Pending.
The actor is the active Caretaker.

steps: Approve the pending registration request as the active Caretaker.
Inspect its status and decision record.

expected_result: The request is approved and its decision is recorded.

source_id: BR-MMS-010 Verify the active Caretaker can reject a deregistration request and the Student remains registered pending any other stated lifecycle effect.
purpose: Verify the active Caretaker can reject a deregistration request and the Student remains registered pending any other stated lifecycle effect.
preconditions: A deregistration request is Pending for a currently registered Student.
The actor is the active Caretaker.

steps: Reject the pending deregistration request.
Inspect the decision and registration state.

expected_result: The request is rejected; the request is not approved for next-day deregistration.

source_id: BR-MMS-010 Verify Warden oversight access does not permit approval or rejection of registration or deregistration requests.
purpose: Verify Warden oversight access does not permit approval or rejection of registration or deregistration requests.
preconditions: A request is Pending.
The actor is Warden.

steps: Attempt request decisions as Warden for each request type.
Inspect statuses and histories.

expected_result: Warden cannot approve or reject either request type; request state and history remain unchanged.

source_id: BR-MMS-011 Verify Warden can view operational student requests for oversight without changing them.
purpose: Verify Warden can view operational student requests for oversight without changing them.
preconditions: Operational student requests exist.
The actor is Warden.

steps: Open the operational-request oversight view as Warden.
Compare request status and history before and after viewing.

expected_result: Permitted request details are viewable; viewing does not alter status or history.

source_id: BR-MMS-012 Verify a currently registered Student can submit a deregistration request when a registration window is not open.
purpose: Verify a currently registered Student can submit a deregistration request when a registration window is not open.
preconditions: The actor is currently registered.
No registration window is open.

steps: Submit a deregistration request outside any registration window.
Inspect the resulting request.

expected_result: The Student may submit the deregistration request; registration-window state does not prevent it.

source_id: BR-MMS-012 Verify an unregistered Student cannot submit a meaningful deregistration request.
purpose: Verify an unregistered Student cannot submit a meaningful deregistration request.
preconditions: The actor is not currently registered.

steps: Attempt to submit a deregistration request.
Inspect request records.

expected_result: No meaningful deregistration request is accepted for a Student who is not registered.

source_id: BR-MMS-013 Verify an approved deregistration becomes effective on the next calendar day after Caretaker approval.
purpose: Verify an approved deregistration becomes effective on the next calendar day after Caretaker approval.
preconditions: A deregistration request is Pending for a registered Student.
The active Caretaker approves it at a known time within a stated calendar date.

steps: Approve the deregistration request.
Inspect the scheduled effective date and registration state before and from the next calendar day.

expected_result: The request's deregistration effect starts from the next calendar day after approval, not at the approval instant.

source_id: BR-MMS-014 Verify a weekly menu contains day-wise entries for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
purpose: Verify a weekly menu contains day-wise entries for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
preconditions: A weekly menu is submitted for publication.

test_data.days: Each of the seven days in the week

steps: Submit a menu with an entry for each required day and meal.
Read the stored/published menu and enumerate its day-meal pairs.

expected_result: The menu is stored with all seven days represented separately for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

source_id: BR-MMS-014 Verify an incomplete weekly day/meal structure is not published as a complete menu.
purpose: Verify an incomplete weekly day/meal structure is not published as a complete menu.
preconditions: A valid menu already exists for the target week.

steps: Submit a menu omitting one required day-meal entry.
Inspect the published menu and prior valid menu.

expected_result: The incomplete structure is not committed as a valid published weekly menu; the prior valid menu remains available.

source_id: BR-MMS-015 Verify publication of a weekly menu update triggers a system-generated notification event to Students.
purpose: Verify publication of a weekly menu update triggers a system-generated notification event to Students.
preconditions: A weekly menu update is ready to publish.
Student recipients are identified for the event.

steps: Publish a weekly menu update.
Inspect the notification trigger/event records for Student recipients.

expected_result: MMS triggers system-generated email notifications to Students for the published menu update; this test ends at the trigger and does not assert external delivery.

source_id: BR-MMS-015 Verify an unsuccessful or unpublished menu submission does not count as a published menu update notification trigger.
purpose: Verify an unsuccessful or unpublished menu submission does not count as a published menu update notification trigger.
preconditions: A valid menu exists.
A proposed update is rejected before publication.

steps: Submit a menu update that is not published.
Inspect notification triggers for the rejected submission.

expected_result: No menu-update notification is triggered for an update that was not published.

source_id: BR-MMS-016 Verify billing periods follow calendar months rather than a rolling period or non-calendar cycle.
purpose: Verify billing periods follow calendar months rather than a rolling period or non-calendar cycle.
preconditions: Billing inputs are supplied for two adjacent calendar months.
Inputs include service facts associated with each month.

test_data.periods: Two consecutive named calendar months, including their month boundary

steps: Generate bills for both supplied periods.
Compare the bill period identifiers and included input period with the calendar-month boundaries.

expected_result: Bills are generated on the calendar-month cycle, with each bill associated with its corresponding month.

source_id: BR-MMS-017 Verify all three specified billing components contribute to the monthly bill computation.
purpose: Verify all three specified billing components contribute to the monthly bill computation.
preconditions: A monthly billing period and Student are eligible for billing.
Rate, served days, approved special-food charge, and approved rebate deduction are supplied inputs.

steps: Generate the monthly bill using the supplied components.
Compare the resulting total to daily_rate multiplied by served_days, plus approved special-food charges, less approved rebate deduction.

expected_result: The bill includes all specified components; for the example inputs, the computed amount is 185.00 before any separately specified treatment.

source_id: BR-MMS-018 Verify a generated bill cannot be published to Students before Caretaker review and finalization, and can be published after finalization.
purpose: Verify a generated bill cannot be published to Students before Caretaker review and finalization, and can be published after finalization.
preconditions: A bill is generated and not finalized.
Actor is the active Caretaker.

steps: Attempt publication while the bill is Generated and unfinalized.
Review and finalize the bill as Caretaker.
Publish it and inspect Student availability.

expected_result: The bill is not published before Caretaker finalization; after review/finalization, publication to Students is permitted.

source_id: BR-MMS-019 Verify an approved rebate is applied as a deduction to the corresponding monthly bill.
purpose: Verify an approved rebate is applied as a deduction to the corresponding monthly bill.
preconditions: A rebate request has Approved status and approved dates in a billed month.
Rate and served days are provided.

test_data.period: Month overlapping the approved rebate dates

steps: Generate the corresponding monthly bill.
Inspect its rebate deduction and total.

expected_result: The bill applies the deduction for the approved rebate according to the supplied bill inputs and approved dates.

source_id: BR-MMS-019 Verify Pending and Rejected rebate requests do not adjust monthly bills.
purpose: Verify Pending and Rejected rebate requests do not adjust monthly bills.
preconditions: Comparable billing inputs are available for two scenarios.
One rebate is Pending in the first scenario and Rejected in the second.

steps: Generate each scenario's bill using equivalent service and rate inputs.
Compare rebate deductions against the scenario without an approved rebate.

expected_result: Neither Pending nor Rejected rebate changes the monthly bill; no rebate deduction is applied for either status.

source_id: BR-MMS-020 Verify Student text feedback is stored and visible to the Caretaker.
purpose: Verify Student text feedback is stored and visible to the Caretaker.
preconditions: A Student is authenticated.
A non-empty feedback message is provided.

steps: Submit Student feedback.
As Caretaker, view the feedback entries.

expected_result: The feedback is stored and visible to the Caretaker for monitoring/reporting; no resolution outcome is implied.

source_id: BR-MMS-020 Verify Student text feedback is visible to the Warden for supervisory monitoring/reporting.
purpose: Verify Student text feedback is visible to the Warden for supervisory monitoring/reporting.
preconditions: A feedback entry exists.
Actor is Warden.

steps: View feedback entries as Warden.
Compare feedback records before and after viewing.

expected_result: The Warden can view the stored feedback; viewing does not imply a complaint-resolution workflow or alter the record.

source_id: BR-MMS-021 Verify a rebate request shorter than three days is rejected.
purpose: Verify a rebate request shorter than three days is rejected.
preconditions: A registered Student submits a rebate request with otherwise valid data.

steps: Submit the short-duration request.
Inspect the response and rebate records.

expected_result: MMS rejects the request and does not record it as Pending.

source_id: BR-MMS-021 Verify a request meeting the stated minimum three-day duration is not rejected for being below the minimum.
purpose: Verify a request meeting the stated minimum three-day duration is not rejected for being below the minimum.
preconditions: A registered Student submits a request with valid reason and lead time.

steps: Submit a request covering three consecutive calendar days.
Inspect whether it is accepted or rejected specifically for minimum duration.

expected_result: MMS does not reject the request for having fewer than three days; the stated minimum is met.

source_id: BR-MMS-022 Verify a rebate request submitted at least one calendar day before its start date satisfies the lead-time rule.
purpose: Verify a rebate request submitted at least one calendar day before its start date satisfies the lead-time rule.
preconditions: A registered Student submits a valid rebate duration and reason.

test_data.start_date: The next calendar day or later relative to submission date

steps: Submit a rebate request with start date at least one calendar day ahead.
Inspect whether it is rejected for insufficient lead time.

expected_result: MMS does not reject the request for failing the specified one-calendar-day lead time.

source_id: BR-MMS-022 Verify a rebate request with less than one calendar day of lead time is rejected.
purpose: Verify a rebate request with less than one calendar day of lead time is rejected.
preconditions: A registered Student submits an otherwise valid rebate request.

test_data.start_date: Current calendar date or otherwise less than one calendar day after submission

steps: Submit the request with insufficient lead time.
Inspect request records.

expected_result: MMS rejects the request and does not create a Pending rebate.

source_id: BR-MMS-023 Verify a new rebate request whose date range overlaps an existing request is prevented.
purpose: Verify a new rebate request whose date range overlaps an existing request is prevented.
preconditions: A Student has an existing Pending or Approved rebate request.
A second request overlaps at least one date of the first.

test_data.new_range: Interval sharing at least one date with existing range

steps: Submit the overlapping second request.
Inspect both requests.

expected_result: MMS prevents the overlapping request and preserves the existing request.

source_id: BR-MMS-023 Verify non-overlapping rebate requests are not rejected by the non-overlap rule.
purpose: Verify non-overlapping rebate requests are not rejected by the non-overlap rule.
preconditions: A Student has an existing rebate request.
A second otherwise valid request has a disjoint date range.

test_data.new_range: Valid range with no shared dates

steps: Submit the second non-overlapping request.
Inspect the response and both requests.

expected_result: The second request is not rejected for overlap; the first remains unchanged.

source_id: BR-MMS-024 Verify each specified rebate reason is accepted when all other requirements are met, including an explanation for Other.
purpose: Verify each specified rebate reason is accepted when all other requirements are met, including an explanation for Other.
preconditions: Student is currently registered.
Dates meet the duration and lead-time requirements.

steps: Submit one otherwise valid request for each listed reason.
Inspect the recorded reason and explanation.

expected_result: The four specified categories are accepted as reasons when the stated requirements are met; Other retains its supplied explanation.

source_id: BR-MMS-024 Verify a missing reason, an unsupported reason, or Other without an explanation is not accepted.
purpose: Verify a missing reason, an unsupported reason, or Other without an explanation is not accepted.
preconditions: Student is currently registered.
All other rebate fields are valid.

invalid_cases: Reason outside the four named categories
Other with omitted or empty explanation

steps: Submit each invalid reason case separately.
Inspect whether a rebate request is created.

expected_result: MMS requires a supported reason and requires an explanation for Other; invalid cases are not recorded as valid Pending requests.

source_id: BR-MMS-025 Verify the dates on an approved request without date modification are the dates used for billing adjustment.
purpose: Verify the dates on an approved request without date modification are the dates used for billing adjustment.
preconditions: A rebate is Pending with valid submitted dates.
The active Caretaker approves it without modifying dates.
A bill covers the approved date period.

steps: Approve the rebate using the submitted dates.
Generate/inspect the corresponding bill adjustment.

expected_result: The approved submitted dates are the dates used for the billing adjustment.

source_id: BR-MMS-025 Determine acceptance limits and billing effects when Caretaker modifies rebate dates before approval.
purpose: Determine acceptance limits and billing effects when Caretaker modifies rebate dates before approval.
preconditions: A Pending rebate request exists.
An external mess policy would have to define permitted modifications.

steps: Attempt to establish permitted modified dates and the resulting approved dates.
action_or_input.blocked_reason: The specifications condition date changes on external mess policy but do not define permitted ranges, limits, or acceptance outcomes. No modified date range or expected result can be asserted.

source_id: BR-MMS-026 Verify vacation survey notifications/availability are limited to currently registered Students.
purpose: Verify vacation survey notifications/availability are limited to currently registered Students.
preconditions: A vacation survey is created.
There is at least one currently registered Student and one not currently registered Student.

steps: Create the survey for an upcoming vacation.
Inspect the intended survey recipients/availability for both Student states.

expected_result: Only currently registered Students receive the survey; a non-registered Student is excluded.

source_id: BR-MMS-027 Verify a registered Student who does not respond before the deadline receives a default No response.
purpose: Verify a registered Student who does not respond before the deadline receives a default No response.
preconditions: A survey and response deadline exist.
The Student is currently registered and has not responded before the deadline.

steps: Process the survey at its response deadline.
Inspect the Student's recorded response.

expected_result: MMS records No as the default response for the registered nonresponding Student.

source_id: BR-MMS-027 Verify an explicit response submitted before the deadline is not replaced by default No.
purpose: Verify an explicit response submitted before the deadline is not replaced by default No.
preconditions: A registered Student has explicitly answered before the survey deadline.

steps: Process the survey deadline for each explicit-response scenario.
Inspect the recorded response.

expected_result: The explicit Yes or No remains the response; default No applies only to Students who did not respond before the deadline.

source_id: BR-MMS-027 Determine the outcome for a response submitted exactly at the response-deadline instant.
purpose: Determine the outcome for a response submitted exactly at the response-deadline instant.
preconditions: A response deadline has an exact timestamp.
A Student submission is timestamped exactly at that instant.

steps: Submit/process the response at the exact deadline boundary.
Determine whether it counts as before the deadline or as nonresponse.
action_or_input.blocked_reason: The specifications say 'before the deadline' and default at the deadline but do not state whether a response at the exact deadline instant is timely. No boundary convention is assumed.

source_id: BR-MMS-028 Verify a special-food request submitted at least one calendar day before its requested date is allowed by the lead-time rule.
purpose: Verify a special-food request submitted at least one calendar day before its requested date is allowed by the lead-time rule.
preconditions: Actor is a Student.
Request has an allowed context: illness or personal event.

test_data.requested_date: At least one calendar day after submission

steps: Submit a special-food request with the specified lead time.
Inspect whether it is rejected for insufficient lead time.

expected_result: The request is not rejected for violating the one-calendar-day lead-time rule.

source_id: BR-MMS-028 Verify a special-food request submitted less than one calendar day before its requested date is not allowed.
purpose: Verify a special-food request submitted less than one calendar day before its requested date is not allowed.
preconditions: Actor is a Student.
Request otherwise has an allowed context.

test_data.requested_date: Same calendar date as submission or less than one calendar day ahead

steps: Submit the insufficient-lead-time request.
Inspect request records.

expected_result: MMS rejects the request and does not record it as Requested.

source_id: BR-MMS-029 Verify the institution-defined timeout threshold and default-rejection boundary.
purpose: Verify the institution-defined timeout threshold and default-rejection boundary.
preconditions: A special-food request is Requested.
The institution has not supplied the decision-period value.

test_data.decision_period: Unspecified; source only notes 12 hours as intended

steps: Determine the exact elapsed time at which default rejection occurs and the behavior at that boundary.
action_or_input.blocked_reason: The exact decision period is institution-defined and is not specified. The intended 12-hour reference is explicitly not a frozen policy value; no numeric threshold or exact-boundary result may be asserted.

source_id: BR-MMS-030 Verify charges for approved special-food requests are added to the Student monthly bill.
purpose: Verify charges for approved special-food requests are added to the Student monthly bill.
preconditions: A special-food request is Approved and has a charge amount supplied by the applicable policy/input source.
A bill is generated for the corresponding month.

steps: Generate the corresponding monthly bill.
Compare its special-food charge component with the approved request charge.

expected_result: The approved special-food charge X is included in the Student's monthly bill; this test does not define the charge amount.

source_id: BR-MMS-030 Determine whether a charge is reversed or suppressed after an approved special-food request is later Cancelled.
purpose: Determine whether a charge is reversed or suppressed after an approved special-food request is later Cancelled.
preconditions: A special-food request was Approved and charged, then marked Cancelled.

steps: Generate or inspect the corresponding monthly bill.
Determine whether the charge is retained, reversed, or suppressed.
action_or_input.blocked_reason: The specifications explicitly leave billing treatment after Cancelled unresolved (ISS-MMS-015). No charge outcome may be invented.

source_id: BR-MMS-031 Verify Request and decision states are tracked as Requested followed by Approved or Rejected.
purpose: Verify Request and decision states are tracked as Requested followed by Approved or Rejected.
preconditions: A Student submits a valid special-food request.
The active Caretaker makes one decision.

steps: Submit a request and inspect its initial status/history.
Run separate approval and rejection scenarios and inspect each resulting status/history.

expected_result: The request begins as Requested and the Caretaker decision is recorded as Approved or Rejected in the applicable scenario.

source_id: BR-MMS-031 Verify who may perform Served/Cancelled transitions and whether invalid pre-approval transitions are rejected.
purpose: Verify who may perform Served/Cancelled transitions and whether invalid pre-approval transitions are rejected.
preconditions: A special-food request is in a known state.

steps: Exercise the specified fulfillment-state transitions and determine the actor permitted to record them.
action_or_input.blocked_reason: The Problem Statement does not explicitly assign the actor who records Served or Cancelled (ISS-MMS-014). A reliable actor/action test cannot be derived without inventing authorization or invocation behavior; resolve the actor before asserting these transitions.

source_id: BR-MMS-032 Verify the active Caretaker may publish a mess-related announcement.
purpose: Verify the active Caretaker may publish a mess-related announcement.
preconditions: The actor holds the active Caretaker role.
Announcement content is provided.

steps: Publish the announcement as the active Caretaker.
Inspect the announcement history.

expected_result: The announcement is published and recorded in history.

source_id: BR-MMS-032 Verify the active Warden may publish a mess-related announcement as announcement owner.
purpose: Verify the active Warden may publish a mess-related announcement as announcement owner.
preconditions: The actor holds the active Warden role.
Announcement content is provided.

steps: Publish the announcement as the active Warden.
Inspect the announcement history.

expected_result: The announcement is published and recorded in history.

source_id: BR-MMS-032 Verify only active Caretaker or active Warden can publish announcements.
purpose: Verify only active Caretaker or active Warden can publish announcements.
preconditions: An announcement is not yet published.
Actors include Student and a non-active Caretaker or Warden.

steps: Attempt to publish as each actor.
Inspect announcement history and notification triggers.

expected_result: Publication is rejected for actors who are not the active Caretaker or active Warden; no announcement is added for rejected attempts.

source_id: BR-MMS-033 Verify published mess-relevant announcements are maintained in history and viewable by Student, Caretaker, and Warden according to stated access rights.
purpose: Verify published mess-relevant announcements are maintained in history and viewable by Student, Caretaker, and Warden according to stated access rights.
preconditions: At least one mess-relevant announcement has been published.
Student, active Caretaker, and Warden actors are available.

steps: Inspect announcement history as each named actor.
Compare returned history with the published announcement records.

expected_result: Announcement history is maintained and viewable by the named actors according to their access rights; viewing does not alter history.

source_id: BR-MMS-033 Determine Mess Admin access to announcement history.
purpose: Determine Mess Admin access to announcement history.
preconditions: Announcement history exists.
Actor is Mess Admin.

steps: Attempt to view announcement history as Mess Admin.
action_or_input.blocked_reason: The Problem Statement says all MMS actors may view history according to access rights but also restricts Mess Admin to role-management and denies operational-data access. Announcement-history access is not explicitly resolved; no permission outcome is assumed.

source_id: BR-MMS-034 Verify Warden can view the specified supervisory reports.
purpose: Verify Warden can view the specified supervisory reports.
preconditions: The actor is Warden.
Report data is available.

steps: Request each specified supervisory report as Warden.
Inspect the report category and returned MMS data.

expected_result: Warden can view the specified supervisory reports within MMS scope.

source_id: BR-MMS-034 Verify Caretaker cannot access supervisory reports restricted to Warden.
purpose: Verify Caretaker cannot access supervisory reports restricted to Warden.
preconditions: Supervisory report data exists.
Actor is Caretaker.

test_data.report: One of the specified supervisory reports

steps: Attempt to request a supervisory report as Caretaker.

expected_result: Access to the Warden-restricted supervisory report is prevented and the report data is not disclosed.

source_id: BR-MMS-034 Verify Caretaker may generate the specified operational reports.
purpose: Verify Caretaker may generate the specified operational reports.
preconditions: The actor is active Caretaker.
Operational report data is available.

steps: Request each specified operational report as Caretaker.
